pages.title: Cursed Eye
pages.text: $(bold)Unlocking this node gives you the Cursed Eye and lets you set it in the ancient portal. Its task is a boss kill when that boss is installed.$(br2)$(thing)28 Focal Shards$(n).$(br2)Kill Helvar.$(br)Without that boss: Kill 100 piglin brutes or wither skeletons.
